state_5.sqlite.name: threads_created_at_ms_after_insert
state_5.sqlite.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER threads_created_at_ms_after_insert
AFTER INSERT ON threads
WHEN NEW.created_at_ms IS NULL
BEGIN
    UPDATE threads
    SET created_at_ms = NEW.created_at * 1000
    WHERE id = NEW.id;
END

state_5.sqlite.name: threads_created_at_ms_after_update
state_5.sqlite.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER threads_created_at_ms_after_update
AFTER UPDATE OF created_at ON threads
WHEN NEW.created_at != OLD.created_at
 AND NEW.created_at_ms IS OLD.created_at_ms
BEGIN
    UPDATE threads
    SET created_at_ms = NEW.created_at * 1000
    WHERE id = NEW.id;
END

state_5.sqlite.name: threads_recency_at_after_insert
state_5.sqlite.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER threads_recency_at_after_insert
AFTER INSERT ON threads
WHEN NEW.recency_at_ms = 0
BEGIN
    UPDATE threads
    SET recency_at = NEW.updated_at,
        recency_at_ms = COALESCE(NEW.updated_at_ms, NEW.updated_at * 1000)
    WHERE id = NEW.id;
END

CREATE TABLE "local_thread_catalog" (
            host_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,

            cwd TEXT,

            conversation_origin TEXT, trial_conversation_type TEXT,

          )
